title: Vault of Tomes
description: A fantasy-inspired book management app where users can discover books, build a personal bookshelf, track reading progress, and write reviews. Built with React, integrating the Open Library API and a JSON Server backend with full CRUD functionality.

title: Resistance Is Fabulous
description: A fun, arcade-style endless runner game where players dodge obstacles to survive as long as possible. Collisions increase the FAB meter, gradually transforming the character until it's game over. Built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML Canvas, and CSS.

title: DoneZo
description: A task management application that helps users stay organised and productive. Users can create, edit, delete, and track tasks, assign priority levels, filter by completion status, and sort tasks by name or priority. Built with React and JavaScript.
